name: Capsule Maid Alice
original_name: カプセルメイドありす
source:
Main character is hired as a temporary clerk of antique shop "LA SAISON". When he throws a capsule from this shop against a wall during an argument, maid girl appears from it...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受聘成为古董店“LA SAISON”的临时店员。一次争执中，他把店里的胶囊扔向墙壁，女仆少女竟从中出现……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-january-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
